build_face_completion_pipeline: build a face completion pipeline using multi-output estimators to predict lower face halves from upper halves
create_olivetti_faces_dataset: create a faces dataset loader using fetch_olivetti_faces to split training and test sets by subject
test_multioutput_estimators: test ExtraTreesRegressor, KNeighborsRegressor, LinearRegression, and RidgeCV on multi-output face completion
refactor_multioutput_predictions: refactor estimator fitting to predict lower-face pixel arrays from upper-face pixel arrays
summarize_face_completion_plot: summarize face completion results by plotting true faces alongside predicted completions from multiple estimators
